input.quote: Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient. This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no non-compete, exclusivity or field-of-use restriction binding us. Section 1 (p0001) does the opposite of the risk this rule targets: it expressly disclaims any exclusive arrangement and confirms the Agreement will not restrict Customer from offering Inventory via other agents or selling Inventory to third parties. Searches for "compet", "exclusiv", "restrict", "solicit", "shall not" and "Customer will not" surfaced no covenant limiting our business lines, products or territory. The only Customer-side prohibitions are the standard software-license protections in Section 6(a) (p0025) — no transfer or third-party access, no modification/derivative works, no reverse engineering, no resale or service-bureau use of the Service. Those protect Kubient's IP in its own platform and are not field-of-use or competing-activity restrictions, so they are not flagged here. The clause meets the preferred position (no non-compete on Customer); no redline required.
